why_fair: The deployed classifier was trained only on IQ-OTH/NCCD; every row of its training split file has source=IQ-OTH. LIDC is a different country, hospitals, scanners and reconstruction pipeline.
caveats: LIDC contains no normal class; this is benign-vs-malignant discrimination, not screening performance.
LIDC labels are averaged radiologist impression (1-5), not pathology.
Nodules with a mean malignancy of exactly 3 were excluded as indeterminate.
Slices are lesion-centred by construction, so prevalence here is not clinical prevalence.
